Zero HOT setups? Zero WARM setups? **You gotta be kidding me.** This doesn’t happen often, but when it does, the message couldn’t be any clearer: the market is tightening up and patience is key. With no screaming setups on the board, the squeeze signal is telling us to sit on our hands and let the tape come to us. This isn't the time to push buttons just for the sake of action. Risk is neutral. Full stop.

Zooming out to the broader landscape, this lack of fresh action in the squeeze scans is fascinating. It’s like the market is holding its breath, waiting for the next catalyst. We’re stuck in this murky middle ground—neither fear nor greed has the upper hand. The indices are chopping sideways, testing patience across the board. The S&P? Still locked in a 100-point range. The Nasdaq? A ping-pong game nobody wants to watch. Even crypto is doing its best impression of a rock, sitting flat near the lows. This is the calm before the storm, folks. **The market is coiling, and when it bursts, it’s going to be explosive.** But the direction? That’s the million-dollar question.  

So what’s working right now? Let’s call out the names with juice left to squeeze. $COIN is the star of the show, up 140% from entry even as Bitcoin hovers around $30K. The fact that $COIN is still holding its highs tells us the market isn't throwing in the towel on crypto just yet. Look at $MP and $UUUU—both rare earth and uranium plays that are putting the reactors into overdrive. Triple digits and counting after taking half off at a double? That’s exactly why we trade squeezes.

For those asking about late entries, let’s keep it simple. It’s slim pickings after the initial big moves, but names like $UUUU and $MP are so sticky, they might just have more to give. If you’re already in, ride the wave. If you’re not, time your entries carefully—this isn’t a game of darts. And for those double-down junkies, sorry, but there are no new HOT setups to reload on today. Like I said, patience, patience, patience.

Looking ahead, today’s the final trading day of the week, which means positioning is key. Watch the usual suspects—dollar, yields, crude. Any sudden moves in the big macro gears will set the tone for next week. Also, keep an eye on the uranium and crypto pockets, where leadership is still alive and kicking. **Leadership is everything right now, and it’s our best cheat code for what breaks out after this lull.**    

The bears? They’ve got nothing—absolutely no follow-through anywhere to be seen. But until the bulls show us they’re ready to take the wheel again, we stay tactical, we stay patient, and we keep listening to what the market’s telling us.
